page_note: Page is severely damaged (87.9% damage). Contains end of one chapter (First Man) and beginning of Chapter 112 ('The man is lesser compared to all works of the cosmos'). The new chapter opens with an apostolic narrative frame — Mani walking, encountering a great river, standing in its midst, looking at great mountains. This biographical episode (segs 5-12) is editorial apostolic frame. From seg 13 onward, Mani's speech describes the five-fold cosmos with cosmic geography (mountains, sea, breadth/length/depth) — substratic correspondential content delivered within the apostolic envelope. Heavy lacunae make many segments fragmentary.
